caseNameFull: Carey, Governor of New York v. Sugar and Curtis Circulation Co. v. Sugar

opinions.text: Appeals from D. C. S. D. N. Y. [Probable jurisdiction noted, 421 U. S. 908.] Motion of appellants for additional time for oral argument granted and ten additional minutes allotted for that purpose. Mr. Justice Douglas took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
